candidates.claim: sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/20 is an active (not shutdown) access port in zone VLAN 10, although only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10 and sw-core-01 ports 5-20 are to be unused in VLAN 999 and shut down.
candidates.remediation: Move Gi1/0/20 back to VLAN 999 and shut it down, unless it is formally reclassified as an approved OT-facing port.

candidates.claim: The access VLAN of sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/20 differs from the approved baseline (baseline VLAN 999, current VLAN 10).
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change: revert the switchport access VLAN to 999 or record an approved baseline change.

candidates.claim: The approved baseline shutdown command for sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/20 is absent from the current configuration.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change: restore shutdown on Gi1/0/20 or record an approved baseline change.

clarifications.question: fw-01 has the ASA HTTP server enabled (fw-01:109), and rtr-01 permits any-source TCP/443 and UDP/443 to the fw-01 outside address 203.0.113.2 (rtr-01:68, rtr-01:69). The registry bans IOS HTTP/HTTPS servers and allows HTTPS/ASDM only from MGMT on the mgmt interface, which the mgmt_access record (fw-01:110) meets. Is the ASA HTTP server intended as the permitted ASDM service, and is the Internet-facing 443 permit to the outside address intended?
